fixed.how: Commit fa6a725 (from the fixup run cut off by the restart; kept as is). registry/tools.ts isFileName decides what counts as a file. The ending must be a file's (FILE_EXTENSIONS: md, csv, json, html, js and the like; not NET, IO or com). The word must also not be a TECHNOLOGY: a capitalised one-word name with .js or .ts, or a well-known lower-case one. A path such as src/App.js is still a file. Every other dotted word loses its dots before fileTheWordsWrite reads the clause, so it is never the file and never ends the clause. FILE ends at a word boundary and allows endings of up to 8 characters. When in doubt the plain line shows, and the plain line is true whatever the words ask for.
